summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of BidBlitz V2 Scanner/Payment flow completed successfully. All 5 steps of the payment flow (Amount → Confirm → Scan → Processing → Success) work correctly. All navigation, UI elements, and Context API state management verified working.
passed_tests: Home page loads with user greeting (Good Afternoon), balance (€2,847.65 area), services grid (Wallet, Taxi, Scooter, Food), bottom nav
Navigate to Scanner via center bottom nav button - Scanner page loads
Bottom nav disappears on Scanner page (full-screen experience)
Scanner Step 1 (Amount): Custom numpad visible (1-9, 0, ., del), quick amount chips (€5, €10, €25, €50), PAYMENT AMOUNT label, balance display
Scanner: Continue button disabled when no amount entered (grayed out, not clickable)
Scanner: Tap numpad keys to enter amount (e.g. 2, 5 = 25) - amount display updates correctly
Scanner: Continue button turns active (cyan) when valid amount entered
Scanner: Tap quick amount chip (e.g. €25) - amount display updates, chip highlighted, Continue button activates
Scanner: Delete key works - removes last digit
Scanner: Enter amount exceeding balance (99999) - Balance text turns RED, Continue button stays disabled (not clickable)

Scanner: Click Continue → Step 2 (Confirmation) with €amount, merchant name (Urban Coffee Co.), reference (BLZ-XXXXXX), payment method (BidBlitz Wallet), countdown timer (5:00), Copy button, 'Protected by BidBlitz Secure Pay' badge
Scanner Step 2: 'Show QR & Pay' and 'Edit Amount' buttons present
Scanner Step 2: Edit Amount button returns to Step 1 (Amount input)
Scanner Step 2: Click 'Show QR & Pay' → Step 3 (Scanning) with QR grid, laser animation, progress bar, amount display, reference
Scanner: After scan completes (~4 seconds) → Step 4 (Processing/Verifying Payment) with spinner, 'Contacting payment network...'
Scanner: After processing (~1.8 seconds) → Step 5 (Success) with green checkmark, amount, 'Payment Successful', merchant name, receipt card with reference/status/new balance
Scanner: Balance correctly deducted after payment (€2,847.65 - €10 = €2,837.65)
Scanner Success: Click Done → returns to Home page
Scanner: Back button (X) from Step 1 returns to Home page
Scanner: Back button (chevron) from Step 2 resets to Step 1
Bottom nav visible again after returning from Scanner
Navigate to Wallet page via 'Get Started' button - shows balance, premium card, quick actions
Wallet: Click 'Add Money' → TopUpModal opens with current balance, amount input, presets (€10, €25, €50, €100, €250, €500)
Navigate to Merchant page via bottom nav - shows Händler Dashboard, Today's earnings, Total earnings, Weekly Overview chart, Create Payment button, Recent Payments

Navigate to More page via bottom nav - shows profile (Alex), Premium badge, settings menu (Profile, Cards, Notifications, Security, Appearance, Settings, Help & Support), Log Out button, Version 2.0.0
All 5 bottom nav tabs work correctly (Home, Wallet, Scan, Händler, More)
test_credentials: No credentials needed - all frontend Context API mock data
seed_data_creation: N/A - uses mock data from Context API
context_for_next_testing_agent: BidBlitz V2 is a pure frontend fintech app with no backend. All data is mocked via React Context API (WalletContext, MerchantContext, UserContext). Scanner page has 5 steps: AMOUNT → CONFIRM → SCAN → PROCESSING → SUCCESS/ERROR. Scan takes ~4 seconds, processing takes ~1.8 seconds. After successful payment, balance is deducted from WalletContext. Bottom nav is hidden on Scanner page. Initial balance is ~€2,847.65 (may vary from previous test payments). Mobile viewport recommended: 430x932. Dark mode only.
